name: MCP OpenAPI Connector
description: Enables Claude Desktop and other MCP clients to interact with any OAuth2-authenticated OpenAPI-based API through automatic tool generation from OpenAPI specifications, with built-in token management and authentication handling.

rawRecord.description: Enables Claude Desktop and other MCP clients to interact with any OAuth2-authenticated OpenAPI-based API through automatic tool generation from OpenAPI specifications, with built-in token management and authentication handling.

API_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of the API (e.g., https://api.example.com)

OPENAPI_EXCLUDE.description: Optional comma-separated list of operations to exclude (e.g., deleteItem)

CUSTOM_TOOLS_PATH.description: Optional path to a custom tools JavaScript file

OPENAPI_SPEC_PATH.description: Path to the OpenAPI specification file (JSON format). Required for the server to function.

OPENAPI_TOOL_PREFIX.description: Optional prefix for generated tool names (e.g., api_)

OPENAPI_INCLUDE_ONLY.description: Optional comma-separated list of operations to include (e.g., listItems,createItem)
